#### neumannPlate (elastodynamics)

The manufactured elastodynamics problem of
`elastodynamics/vectorLBM/periodicPlate` with a traction boundary instead of a
periodic one. `ElastodynamicsVectorLBMNeumannValidation` prescribes the stress
of the manufactured solution on the boundary, for which the descriptor carries
the boundary coordinates and the outward normal as additional fields.

The `run.sh` script performs the same resolution sweep and order of convergence
study as `elastodynamics/vectorLBM/periodicPlate`.
